blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Addressing rising prices of basic goods and services remains the top national concern of Filipinos, according to a survey conducted by Octa Research. Based on Octa Research’s Tugon ng Masa on Urgent National and Personal Concerns of Adult Filipinos, 42 percent of respondents cited controlling price increases as their top concern. “The share of adult Filipinos who want the administration to act on rising prices of basic goods and services rose from 37 percent in July to 42 percent in September 2026,” Octa said in its findings.
